subject: Acquisition Labs onboarding - AcqID issuance & spend cap confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@acquisitionlabs.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ops@acquisitionlabs.com
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding - onboarding form and initial PO request

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking us through the onboarding demo yesterday. Attached is the completed onboarding form and our initial vendor packet. We are ready to move forward but wanted to confirm how you issue a purchase identifier so we can begin routing invoices.

Quick notes:
- We plan to bill monthly; initial forecast is ~$40k–60k/month for the next quarter.
- We uploaded our invoice line mapping but noticed the Redwood intake form asks for your internal PO number.

Can you advise on timing for receiving a purchase identifier and any documentation you need to set spend caps? Also attaching our preferred charge code breakdown.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships, Acquisition Labs
[Attachment: onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@acquisitionlabs.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, ops@acquisitionlabs.com
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - onboarding form and initial PO request

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the form. A few items we need to close before issuing a formal PO/identifier:

1) Spend cap request: please confirm whether the forecasted $40k–60k/month is a soft estimate or a committed monthly cap request. If you need a hard cap (for billing/crediting), we require finance sign-off.

2) Line items: your mapping had two entries without SKU/charge-code matches (rows 5 and 9). Would you attach a corrected CSV or give us the internal ID used by your billing system so we can map to our ledger?

3) Tax and legal: we need a W-9 (or equivalent) and the SOW to attach to the PO record.

I’ve looped in Monica from procurement to propose a provisional identifier while we secure finance approval. If you can send the corrected CSV and the W-9, we’ll move this to provisional status the same day.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Procurement Lead — Redwood Inference

From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, Elena Park <elena@acquisitionlabs.com>
Cc: ops@acquisitionlabs.com
Date: Sat, 4 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - provisioning AcqID and spend buckets

Hi all —

Thanks, Rafael. Elena, I reviewed the attachment and put together a provisional AcqID mapping to help vendors route invoices while finance completes the cap signoff.

Proposal (provisional):
- Temporary purchase identifier (AcqID): ACQ-PROV-9175
- Initial spend guard: $50,000/month (soft cap) — can be adjusted after 60 days with usage data
- Line item split: allocate charge codes as follows: Services(70%) / Support(20%) / Misc(10%) — see attached CSV with proposed mapping.

Next steps for you: upload corrected lineitem CSV (if my mapping mismatches your invoice labels) and the signed SOW. Once we get confirmation from finance I will request issuance of a formal PO number and move the provisional AcqID to production.

I attached the provisional mapping to this thread.

Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: provisional_acqid_map.csv (CSV)]

From: Vendor Ops <ops@acquisitionlabs.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: finance@acquisitionlabs.com
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - provisioning AcqID and spend buckets

Monica —

Thanks for the provisional AcqID. A couple of operational clarifications before we finalize:

• Will invoices billed to the provisional AcqID be applied to the final PO once issued, or do we need to refile invoices?
• Our billing system prefers one-line invoices per invoice cycle; splitting across your internal charge codes will require us to send multiple invoice lines. Can Redwood accept a single invoice with charge-code metadata rather than separate invoices per line?

We have attached an updated invoice mapping worksheet and the SOW for signature. Finance is on copy to confirm the spend cap.

— Vendor Ops (Acquisition Labs)
[Attachment: updated_invoice_mapping.xlsx (XLSX), signed_sow.pdf (PDF)]

From: connor.obrien@redwood.com <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Vendor Ops <ops@acquisitionlabs.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - final spend cap and PO issuance

Hi everyone —

Finance reviewed the forecast and the SOW. We will approve a monthly spend cap of $50,000 (soft cap with automatic notification at 85% utilization). Please note: for accounting clarity we require invoices to include the vendor SKU/charge-code metadata in the invoice body; a single invoice with line metadata is acceptable and preferred.

I am issuing the formal PO number effective today: ACQ-2026-9175. Please apply this PO number to all invoices going forward; invoices already submitted under ACQ-PROV-9175 will be applied to the formal PO (no need to refile).

Two line-item corrections our team applied to your mapping (attached):
- Row 5: merged duplicated "implementation" codes into a single charge code IMP-101 (previously IMP-101/IMP-201)
- Row 9: corrected currency qualifier from USD to USD-PL (for multi-region billing)

Attachments: corrected_lineitems.csv, signed_sow.pdf (copy).

Monica/Rafael — please confirm if Redwood will enable the 85% alert and whether we should set a hard block at 120% to prevent accidental overrun.

Connor O'Brien
Accounting Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: corrected_lineitems.csv (CSV), signed_sow.pdf (PDF)]
